title: Resolution (McOsker – Rodrigiuez) relative to prohibiting the parking of vehicles that are in excess of 22 feet in length or over 84 inches in height,…
text:
[Council File 26-0008-S15; CD 15]
Resolution (McOsker – Rodrigiuez) relative to prohibiting the parking of vehicles that are in excess of 22 feet in length or over 84 inches in height, during all hours of the day and night, on both sides of certain street segments in Council District 15.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Prohibit the parking of vehicles exceeding 22 feet in length or 84 inches in height on certain street segments in Council District 15.
